title: PhaseShiftMOVE
description: A stealth-based invisibility mechanic activated through sneaking and manual control.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f2aa1c1694c25e267b7d5242e09fc1560cf537e.jpeg)

**PhaseShiftMOVE** introduces a tactical stealth mechanic that allows players to become semi-invisible using sneaking and a configurable activation key.

The system is designed to remain simple, immersive, and balanced while giving players full control over when invisibility is used.

No new items.
No new textures.
Only a lightweight gameplay mechanic.

## 🕶️ Stealth Preparation

- Before invisibility can be activated, the player must:
- Sneak continuously for 15 seconds
- Have empty hands
- Wear no armor
- Once these conditions are met, the player becomes eligible to activate invisibility.
- The ability does not activate automatically.

## 🎮 Manual Activation

- After the 15-second preparation:
- Press the configured activation key to enable invisibility
- Press the key again while sneaking to disable it manually
- The activation key can be fully customized in the Minecraft controls menu.

## 👁️ Automatic Cancel

- Invisibility will automatically cancel if:
- The player stops sneaking
- The player equips armor
- The player holds an item
- This ensures the mechanic stays balanced and prevents abuse during combat.

## ⏳ Cooldown System

- After invisibility ends:
- A 10-minute cooldown begins
- The ability cannot be activated again until the cooldown finishes

## 🎯 Gameplay Purpose

- PhaseShiftMOVE is designed for:
- stealth gameplay
- survival infiltration
- PvP mind games
- roleplay servers
- The mechanic enhances vanilla gameplay without replacing it.

## 🌍 Compatibility

✔ Works in Singleplayer
✔ Works in Multiplayer (mod required for all players)
✔ Works on Servers (must be installed server-side)
